long_biography.plain_text:
When Jim Ayers decided to sell American Health Centers, he wanted its local employees to keep their jobs without having to move. He chose an employee stock ownership plan, selling his stake in stages. The transaction released capital for his investments while giving workers an ownership interest in the business.

His education programme began at his former high school and grew beyond scholarship funding. The foundation pays for dedicated advisers who work with students on college access and educational goals. They collaborate with schools while remaining independent of school administration, giving pupils additional guidance alongside financial help.
